messages:
sophie: Quick heads-up — we need a 1.4.3 hot patch for a tokenization edge-case that's hitting a handful of production requests. Small surface area, revert-safe. target: same-day release if CI is clean.

jamie: I can own the patch. Plan is to create release/1.4.3-patch, cherry-pick the two fix commits, and keep the changelog entry terse.

noah: I reproduced the failure locally, added a regression test that exercises the edge case. Local unit + integration ran green. Will kick off CI smoke once PR is up.

linh: Please add the unit test in the same PR and keep unrelated formatting or lockfile changes out. Also include a one-line changelog under "bugfix".

sophie: Cutoff proposal: 18:00 PT today for PR merge (+ tagging). If we miss it we defer to next maintenance slot. Rollout will be canary 5% for 30m then ramp if metrics OK. @marcus please watch the window 18:30-19:00 PT. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jamie: I'll open the PR in ~10m. PR description will include the two cherry-picked SHAs and a short justification. Requesting review from @linh and @noah.

ci-bot: CI queued — linux/unit, linux/integration, e2e-smoke.

noah: Minimal smoke check you can run against staging once deployed: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/api/v1/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"💡 token test"}' -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n'
```
Expect 200 and tokenization not to throw.

jamie: Steps I'm following locally: 
```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.4.3-patch origin/main
git cherry-pick <sha-fix-tokenize> <sha-add-test>
npm ci && npm test
./scripts/ci-smoke.sh
gh pr create --title "release: 1.4.3 (tokenization edge)" --body "cherry-picks: <sha1>, <sha2>" --base main --head release/1.4.3-patch
```
I'll ensure package.json version bump and keep package-lock unchanged.

linh: Reminder: do not include generated protobufs or vendor files. If the cherry-pick pulls any build artifacts, drop them from the commit.

marcus: I'll be on-call during the window and have the rollback playbook ready. If canary exceeds 5% error budget, we'll revert the tag and roll back to v1.4.2.

jamie: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4321 — CI running. tagging updates in the PR description.

ci-bot: build passed — linux/unit ✅, linux/integration ✅, e2e-smoke flaky=0 ✅

noah: Quick note for rollout: monitor kv-cache hit-rate and median gen latency. If latency increases >5% across p50/p95, abort ramp.

sophie: After merge, bump package.json to 1.4.3, tag `v1.4.3`, and trigger the release pipeline (`deploy/release-prod`). Keep rollout params: canary 5% / 30m then 50% / 15m then 100% if healthy.

jamie: Merged at 1769454200, tag pushed and release job triggered. Will post back when canary is live. :shipit:

marcus: Canary live at 1769454360. Watching dashboards now.

noah: Canary metrics look stable so far, kv-cache hit-rate steady, latency within 2%.

sophie: Great. Continue to monitor for full ramp. Thanks all — moving to async. Ping here with any rollback or postmortem if anything pops.

jamie: Final note in PR: "cherry-pick cleanup: removed accidental whitespace changes". Keeping diff minimal.

sophie: :thumbsup:
